evidence.observation: H701 reads 356.129 °C versus H702 at 92.718 °C and reboiler liquid at 82.330 °C; the isolated heater-temperature discrepancy warrants verification.
Discrepancy persists: H701 358.177 °C, H702 94.561 °C, and reboiler 84.477 °C; these readings cannot distinguish actual localized overheating from a temperature-measurement fault.

Pressure and flows remain broadly stable: PY23 698.215 mbar, differential pressures 0.816 and 1.920 mbar, distillate 0.265, reflux 0.572, and cooling-water flow 7.293; no corroborating system-wide upset.
